Here is the weekly ASX X (Twitter) thread for the week of 26 October 2026:

Post 1

ASX closed at 8,412 pts last week and the central question is whether that level holds as Q3 earnings season accelerates. Mixed signals from Wall St and a stubborn AUD keep the bias cautious into Monday. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 2

🏦 Banks face margin pressure as net interest income data hits this week. ⛏️ Mining watches iron ore at USD 98/t — a break below USD 95/t changes the BHP and RIO narrative fast. #banking #ironore #ASX

Post 3

Pilbara Minerals reports this week with spodumene spot near USD 820/t. That price keeps margins thin and the market will want guidance, not just volume numbers. #lithium #mining #ASX

Post 4

📉 S&P 500 closed at 5,718 pts Friday. Tech earnings from mega-caps land mid-week US time — any miss on forward guidance flows directly into ASX tech and growth names at the open. #ASX #ausbiz #markets

Post 5

RBA decision Wednesday. Market prices no change at 4.10%, but trimmed mean CPI at 3.4% keeps a hike optionality alive. Surprise hold with hawkish tone lifts AUD, pressures REITs. Cut talk would spike equities. Which way are you positioned? #RBA #inflation #ASX

Post 1
⛏️ Lithium led the charge while defensives got dumped. ASX 200 added 14.70pts (+0.17%) to 8,809.90 — a narrow gain hiding a sharp rotation out of health care and into materials. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 2
🔺 Materials +1.71%, A-REITs +1.32%, IT +1.03%. 🔻 Consumer Staples -1.54%, Consumer Discretionary -0.96%. Risk-on tone, but only selectively — defensives were clearly unwanted today. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 3
PLS surged +8.40% to AUD 2.84 while ZIP added +10.96% to AUD 1.62. Two very different stories — one lithium, one fintech — both flashing the same message: risk appetite is back in pockets. #lithium #fintech #ASX

Post 4
🪙 Gold at AUD 5,718.19/oz. Silver AUD 76.82/oz. With Materials the top sector today, precious metals pricing is doing the heavy lifting on sentiment. AUD/USD sits at 0.7030. #gold #silver #metals #ASX

Post 5
8,809.90 is the line. ASX is up 1.10% YTD but down 0.40% over five days — the index is grinding. Does materials momentum hold, or do defensives snap back? What's your read for Tuesday? #ASX #ausbiz
